content.content:
## Validation Report: --branch flag for agt init

### Quality Gates
- ✅ Typecheck: pass
- ✅ Lint: pass  
- ✅ All 649 existing tests: pass (0 failures)

### Build Issue
Library was NOT rebuilt after implementation. Running `agt init --branch testing` failed with "unknown option" until manual `bun run build`. Developer must build and verify CLI output before marking done.

### Critical Bugs

**BUG 1 — Double directory creation (BLOCKER)**
`agt init --branch custom` creates BOTH `.agentrack/` (unused regular dir with stale data) AND `.custom/` (the actual worktree). The `.agentrack/` directory is a leftover from tracker init running before the branch flag takes effect. Users get junk data on disk.

**BUG 2 — Missing BRANCH_CONFLICT detection**
Spec requires error when branch exists with non-agentrack content. Currently silently succeeds — overwrites unrelated branch data.

### Spec Compliance by AC

| AC | Status | Detail |
|----|--------|--------|
| AC1: --branch flag | ⚠️ PARTIAL | Normalization correct for all spec cases. `--branch ""` treated as default instead of erroring. |
| AC2: Config + pointer file | ⚠️ PARTIAL | Pointer file created for custom branches ✅. Config has branch field ✅. Default init also writes branch:"_agentrack" to config (spec says omit for backward compat). |
| AC3: Push/pull | ✅ PASS | Push works with custom branch. Correct pointer file read. |
| AC4: Worktree refactor | ✅ PASS | Constants parameterized, WorktreeOptions pattern works. |
| AC5: resolution.ts | ⚠️ UNVERIFIED | Can't access source. 76% coverage, lines 25-29 uncovered. |
| AC6: Error cases | ⚠️ PARTIAL | INVALID_BRANCH_NAME works for slashes/spaces/invalid chars ✅. Empty name not rejected ✗. BRANCH_CONFLICT not implemented ✗. Slash message generic (not spec-specific). |
| AC7: Backward compat | ⚠️ PARTIAL | Default init works, existing tests pass ✅. Config includes branch field even for default init (deviation from spec). |
| AC8: Slash rejection | ✅ PASS | Slashes rejected correctly. |

### Test Coverage for Changed Files
- `branch-config.ts` (NEW): **22.95%** line coverage — barely tested
- `init.ts` (core of feature): **7.95%** line coverage — no tests
- `push.ts`/`pull.ts`: **0%** function coverage
- **No integration tests for --branch flag at all**
- All 649 tests are pre-existing; none cover new functionality

### Verdict: NOT READY

Two critical bugs (double directory, missing BRANCH_CONFLICT) and zero test coverage for the new feature. Needs rework before release.
Validation complete. Reassigning to CTO (self) with findings. Implementation needs rework for double-directory bug and missing BRANCH_CONFLICT.
